Hongkow
September 30th, 40.

3.

At about 9 a.m. 30/9/40, the undersigned attended the Japanese Consular Police and was informed that at first, the gun man C.Igarashi strongly denied his intention to murder the Chinese female Zung Siau Mai(張小妹), but upon being closely questioned by D.I. K.Takahashi of the J.C.Police, he admitted his murderous intent of the said Chinese female and stated as follows:-

At about 2.30 p.m.,26/9/40, he had visited a brothel at No.6 Lau Kwen Road near Boone Road and for the sum of $4.00, engaged the late Chinese female Zung Siau Mai. Before lying with her he completely undressed and placed his clothing together with the pistol at the foot of the bed.

At about 4.20 p.m., same date, on leaving the brothel at above place, the gun man C.Igarashi quarrelled with the deceased about meeting her and owing to her attitude, he produced his pistol from the right pocket of his trousers with a view to kill the female on the spot, she then screamed " If you can kill me do so ", then in the excitement he placed the gun against her left breast and fired thereby fatally wounding her,. He reported immediately to his employer, Mr.K.Nishi, at No.165 Broadway that he had accidentally shot the Chinese female.

At about 4.30 p.m.,26/9/40, the alleged man C.Igarashi accompanied by Mr.K.Nishi surrendered to the Japanese Consular Police.

（批：C 1/10）
（批：Who）

3.

1940年9月30日上午9时许，具名者前往日本领事馆警察署，获悉持枪男子C. Igarashi（五十岚）起初强烈否认其谋杀中国女子张小妹（Zung Siau Mai）的意图，但在日本领事馆警察局侦探长K. Takahashi（高桥）的严密讯问下，他承认了对该中国女子的谋杀意图，并陈述如下：-

1940年9月26日下午2时30分许，他前往布恩路（Boone Road）附近老闸路（Lau Kwen Road）6号的一家妓院，以4.00元的价格包下了已故中国女子张小妹。在与她同床之前，他完全脱去衣服，并将衣物连同手枪一起放在床脚。

同日约下午4时20分，持枪男子C. Igarashi在离开上述地点的妓院时，就再次见面一事与死者发生争吵，因她的态度，他从裤子右口袋中掏出手枪，意图当场杀死该女子，她随即喊道：“你要杀就杀”，随后他在激动中将枪抵住她的左胸并开枪，致其受致命伤。他立即向其雇主K. Nishi（西）先生报告，称自己意外射伤了中国女子，地址为百老汇路（Broadway）165号。

1940年9月26日下午4时30分许，涉嫌男子C. Igarashi在K. Nishi先生的陪同下向日本领事馆警察署自首。

（批注：C 10月1日）
（批注：Who）

accused O.Igarashi under Rule 199 of the Japanese Criminal
Code for murder and will be sent in a few days to the Nagasak
District Court where he will be tried.

2.

In the course of further enquiries, at about 9 a.m.
28/9/40 the undersigned and C.L.C.251 proceeded to Pooming
Hospital and were informed that the female Chinese named
Zung Siao Mei (陈小妹) had died in the presence of a
Japanese Consular Police at about 6 p.m.,27/9/40 after
having been operated and the bullet could not be extracted
from the deceased.

J.C.Police Sub-Inspector R.K.Takahashi stated
that the dead body will be taken by injured party and not
necessary request by the J.C.Police.

The certification states that "bullet wound in
chest and abdomen." "She died after surgical operation
on 27th. Intestines injured by a bullet."
"The bullet could not be taken out."

(Certification attached.)

Sen. Det. I/c.
D. D. O. "C".
M. Shibasaki
D.P.S.666

2.

在进一步调查过程中，1940年9月28日上午9时许，具名者与华籍巡长251号前往普明医院（Pooming Hospital），获悉名为陈小妹（Zung Siao Mei）的中国女子在日本领事馆警察在场的情况下，于1940年9月27日下午6时许死亡；经手术未能从死者体内取出子弹。

日本领事馆警察副督察R.K. Takahashi（高桥）表示，尸体将由受害方领回，无需日本领事馆警察局提出请求。

证明书写明：“胸部和腹部枪伤。”“她于27日手术后死亡。肠道被子弹击伤。”
“子弹无法取出。”

（附证明书。）

高级警探主管
"C"区副警务总监
M. Shibasaki（柴崎）
D.P.S.666

1.

Re the accidental shooting by a Japanese
   subject of a female Chinese
------------------------------------------

At 3.20 p.m. on 25-9-40, a telephone communication
was received from the C.C.A., to the effect that the
S.B. ambulance had been called to Lau Kwen Road, near
Boone Road, where a Chinese female was lying injured as
the result of a shooting affray.

D.S.I. Watanabi, D.S. Crossley and the undersigned
attended, to find that the scene of the occurrence was
House No.6, Lau Kwan Road, the Japanese Consular Police
were already in attendance and had taken the situation in
hand.

However, the above officers proceeded to the 1st
floor front room of House No.6 Lau Kwen Road, where a
Chinese female one Zung Siau Mai (陈小妹), age 19 years,
native of Tsang-chow, s/prostitute, was found lying on a
bed suffering from a gunshot wound on the left chest.

D.S. Yoshikawa, of the Consular Police, present in the
room, stated that the Consular Police had already effected
the arrest of one Japanese named G. Igarashi, age 26,
s/watchman, residing O.O.L., who had admitted the shooting
and handed over to the Consular Police, the pistol from
which the shot had been fired a French make "Demon", .25,
No.3401, a search of the room, revealed one cartridge

杂项案卷号：535/40。        虹口
                         1940年9月26日。
1.

关于一名日本臣民意外射击一名中国女子之事
------------------------------------------

1940年9月25日下午3时20分，接到中央捕房（C.C.A.）电话通知，称特别处救护车已被召往布恩路（Boone Road）附近的老闸路（Lau Kwen Road），那里有一名中国女子因枪击纠纷受伤倒地。

副督察渡边（Watanabi）、侦探克罗斯利（Crossley）及具名者赶赴现场，发现事发地点为老闸路（Lau Kwan Road）6号，日本领事馆警察已在场并控制了局势。

然而，上述官员前往老闸路6号的前楼房间，发现一名名叫陈小妹（Zung Siau Mai）的中国女子躺在床上，左胸中枪。该女子19岁，籍贯常州，职业妓女。

当时在场的领事馆警察吉川（Yoshikawa）侦探表示，领事馆警察已逮捕了一名名叫G. Igarashi（五十岚）的日本男子，26岁，职业守夜人，住址不详（O.O.L.），该男子承认开枪，并向领事馆警察移交了发射子弹的手枪，为一支法国制造的“Demon”牌，口径.25，编号3401。对房间的搜查发现了一枚

pages.en:
1/2.

shell fired from his pistol, which the Consular Police
took away. The injured female who appeared very weak,
probably from internal bleeding, when questioned before
being removed to the Foo Ming Hospital, was only able
to say "a Japanese shot me."

The Japanese responsible for the shooting who had
after the occurrence given himself up to the Consular
Police, made a statement to the effect that at about
2.30 p.m. even date, he had visited No.6 Lau Kwen Road,
a brothel and for the sum of $4.00, engaged the injured
female Sung Hsau Chi. He had prior to lying on the bed
with the female completely undressed and placed his
clothing together with the above described pistol at
the foot of the said bed. At about 4.20 p.m. having
satisfied his sexual desire for the female, he arose and
whilst in the act of dressing was asked by her to show
her the pistol, he willingly complied and forgetting that
it was loaded pressed the trigger with the result that
it being pointed direct at her, the bullet entered her
breast. Alarmed at what had occurred he hurriedly
proceeded to the Consular Police office on Mingheng Road,
near Whangpoo Road, to report the matter.

The injured female has been detained in the Foo Ming
Hospital, medical certificate issued stating "Bullet
wound of stomach." Meanwhile the Consular Police,
pages.zh:
1/2.

由其手枪发射的弹壳，被领事馆警察带走。受伤女子显得非常虚弱，可能是内出血所致，在被送往福明医院（Foo Ming Hospital）前接受询问时，仅能说出“一个日本人打了我”。

对枪击负责的日本人事发后已向领事馆警察自首，其陈述大意如下：当日约下午2时30分，他前往老闸路6号的一家妓院，以4.00元的价格包下了受伤女子Sung Hsau Chi（音译：宋小芝）。在与该女子上床之前，他完全脱去衣服，并将衣物连同上述手枪一起放在床脚。约下午4时20分，在满足了对该女子的性欲后，他起身穿衣，此时女子要求他给她看手枪，他欣然照办，却忘记枪已上膛，扣动了扳机，结果枪口正对着她，子弹射入其乳房。他对发生的事感到惊慌，急忙前往位于黄埔路（Whangpoo Road）附近的闵行路（Mingheng Road）领事馆警察署报告此事。

受伤女子被留置在福明医院，出具的医疗证明书写明“腹部枪伤”。与此同时，领事馆警察，

pages.en:
1/3.

having accepted the affair as an accidental shooting
are proceeding with investigations.
    No witnesses to the shooting were located on scene
of affair.

M. Shibashi
D.P.S. 666.

Sen. Det. i/c.

D.D.O. "C".
pages.zh:
1/3.

将此案作为意外枪击事件受理，正在进行调查。
    在现场未找到枪击事件的目击者。

M. Shibashi（柴桥/石桥?）
D.P.S. 666.

高级警探主管

"C"区副警务总监
